question: In August 2024, Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR) and Panacea Biotec announced the initiation of the first-ever Phase 3 clinical trial for which of the following vaccines in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dengue**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• In August 2024, the Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR) and Panacea Biotec announced the initiation of the first-ever Phase 3 clinical trial for a Dengue vaccine in India.
 
• The trial aims to evaluate the efficacy and safety of the tetravalent Dengue vaccine developed by Panacea Biotec.
 
• This vaccine targets all four serotypes of the Dengue virus, which is crucial for providing comprehensive protection.
 
• The Phase 3 trial will involve thousands of participants across multiple sites in India to ensure robust data.
 
• The goal is to develop a vaccine that can significantly reduce the incidence of Dengue, a mosquito-borne viral infection that poses a significant public health challenge in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Dengue Virus**

 
 
• Dengue is caused by four distinct serotypes of the Dengue virus (DENV-1, DENV-2, DENV-3, and DENV-4).
 
• Infection with one serotype provides lifelong immunity against that serotype but not against the others.
 
• Subsequent infections with different serotypes increase the risk of severe Dengue, also known as Dengue Hemorrhagic Fever (DHF).
 
 
 
• **Clinical Trials**
 
 
• Clinical trials are research studies performed in people to evaluate a medical, surgical, or behavioral intervention.
 
• They are the primary way researchers find out if a new treatment, like a new drug or diet or medical device, is safe and effective in people.
 
• Phase 3 trials are conducted to confirm and expand on the safety and effectiveness results obtained in Phase 1 and 2 trials.
 
 
 
• **ICMR (Indian Council of Medical Research)**
 
 
• ICMR is the apex body in India for the formulation, coordination, and promotion of biomedical research.
 
• It is one of the oldest and largest medical research bodies in the world.
 
• ICMR plays a crucial role in the development and implementation of health policies in India.
 
 
 
• **Panacea Biotec**
 
 
• Panacea Biotec is one of India's leading biotechnology companies.
 
• The company focuses on research, development, manufacturing, and commercialization of pharmaceuticals, vaccines, and biosimilars.
 
• Panacea Biotec has a strong portfolio of vaccines and has contributed significantly to public health initiatives in India.
